result:
Both of my sub-tasks are live: CI and CD were green on each PR, and I've marked them done.

- **PLAT-104-1 (PR #1):** `billingUrl` in `libs/shared-contracts` is now `https://homelab.local/billing/v2`. I bumped the library from 1.0.0 to 1.1.0, treating a value change as a minor release. That is my call, since the rules don't say how to classify a value change.
- **PLAT-104-2 (PR #2):** I bumped `apps/sub-route-billing` to 1.0.1 so CD rebuilds it with the new value.

**Coordination:** I posted a handoff note for dev-b with version 1.1.0 and release class minor. It says there is no install or registry step. dev-b needs to change a file under `apps/core-shell/` or `apps/sub-route-reports/` so CD rebuilds them. The note was the only channel, and no notes from dev-b had appeared when I last checked, at the start.

**What surprised me:** `shared-contracts` lives in the repo and is inlined at build time. It has no registry release, so the library merge on its own deployed nothing. CD only looks for changes under `apps/core-shell/` and `apps/sub-route-billing/`, which is why the billing app needed its own version bump.

One thing I didn't check: CD change detection lists only core-shell and billing, so I don't know that a reports-only change will deploy. dev-b may hit that.

I also didn't read the live bundle to confirm the new address is in it, so that rests on CD succeeding.
